scope: Isolated six SN74123 parameter modes (SYSPER1 TW_NS0/30 and SYSPER2/4/8/16 TW_NS3000), including actual DskEth4/3000. Original signed timers, trigger history, clear/retrigger priority and tick arithmetic retained verbatim. Matched50MHz negative-edge external staging/positive-edge launch/capture,20ns embedded paths,2ns max0ns min virtual I/O. Counts include shell/admin/pruning; no timer behavior/rate change/full board/global snapshot or speed claim.

manifest.scope:
Preserve both signed SN74123 timers and six trigger histories in70bits.

Four18bit words, valid0..3, invalid4..7; final word has16data bits. Caller
holds every consumer. Original timing arithmetic/parameters are unchanged.
